title: Knightartorias7's Dimensions
description: This is a mod where there are more dimensions with the block that the portal is made of, that dimension is made out of.
body:
# Features
**This mod adds two new dimensions to the game, a new weapon, and two lighters for the new dimensions portals. The two dimensions are the diamond dimension and the steel dimension. To make the portals you get the required block and place it in the way that you would make a nether portal. The new weapon is the steel short sword, and the sword does eight attack damage. each portal/dimension get its own lighter. all crafting recipes will be in the gallery.**
## Why did I make this mod?
**I made this mod because I wanted to try and make something for the minecraft community. At first I wanted to make like a minecraft map or somthing, but then I thought "Im going to forget about this and not update the map and the map will stop working over time" and so I thought about making a modpack and then I saw a modpack that I had previously tried to upload to modrinth but failed and didnt make it onto the platform publicly, so I thought about mod making. When making this mod, I had confidence when starting it, but after a few hours of making it, I started to rethink this. But I kept going and the reason I kept going is because I wanted to do this for the community, and for fun.**
### Will I keep the mod up to date
**This depends, I have to update my coding software, get new plugins for it and stuff like that. Even though those reasons are a setback, I will try to update it, but I wont be porting it over to any other mod loaders such as fabric or quilt or forge. I will do some of the mod making on stream sometimes and so if you are interested in watching me make it, check the channel out here.** [My channel](https://youtube.com/@knightartorias7)
